feature: Spoken approaching-stop announcements for followed bus
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (local Windows voice, not Orbit call voice)
trigger: Confirmed next stop and actual position at most 45 seconds old; official incoming status, or two newer GPS fixes moving at least 5 m closer within 150 m
guards: pause, selection change, hidden window and app quit cancel
deduplication per vehicle/trip/stop sequence, expires after six hours
limits: Feed refresh is not continuous; announcement timing can lag real movement.
Windows voice is a fallback; exact Orbit voice is unavailable.
